image_policy.style: fine blue-gray linework, low-saturation pastel educational textbook illustration
image_policy.content: No readable text, numbers, logos, flags, watermarks, labels, captions, or speech bubbles. Historical imagery is non-graphic and uses blank scrolls or bamboo slips.

assets.prompt: Create one independent square PNG educational textbook illustration for the Chinese vocabulary concept “曾经” meaning “once / in the past”. Show a gentle, clearly readable visual of the same person looking at a small framed memory scene of their earlier life, with a subtle past-versus-present composition and no written text. Approved classroom illustration style: fine blue-gray linework, low-saturation pastel colors, pure white background, generous negative space, simple friendly shapes, calm and concrete. No readable Chinese, Latin letters, numbers, labels, captions, logos, watermark, flag, speech bubble, or decorative abstract symbolism. The image must serve the meaning of a past experience, not be generic decoration. Square composition, clean edges, no border, no text.
